title: Phase E campaign configuration
description: The versioned shape run.ps1 accepts. Bumping schemaVersion is what tells an older orchestrator to refuse a newer file rather than misread it.

artifactsRoot.description: Repository-relative or absolute. One directory per campaign is created beneath it.

campaignPrefix.description: Leading component of the generated campaign id.

id.description: The scenario id used in selection, schedules and scenario result paths.

workerId.description: Schema v2 process identity and directory name beneath workers/. Defaults to id for a v1 entry.

artifactLayoutVersion.description: Version 2 places harness artifacts beneath workers/<workerId>/<scenarioId>. Omitted entries retain the v1 layout.

project.description: Repository-relative csproj, built explicitly with -Build. Never through dotnet test.

executable.description: Repository-relative or absolute path. Supports the {seed} {artifacts} {campaignId} {workerId} {schedule} {duration} {durationSeconds} tokens.

adopts.description: Resources the scenario adopts but does not own, recorded in owned.json for reconciliation. The orchestrator never starts or stops these.

faultKinds.description: Kinds this scenario can dispatch. The orchestrator places them in time and never interprets them; an empty list means the scenario receives no faults.

modes.description: Keyed by campaign mode: smoke, recovery, soak.

kind.description: Checked without being read: preflight reports whether the variable is set, never its value.
